## I turn complex data into clear business decisions.

I am a Data Science and Analytics Leader with 15+ years of experience building analytics capabilities, leading multidisciplinary teams and translating data into measurable business impact.

My background spans product analytics, commercial analytics, marketing measurement, experimentation and machine learning. I have worked across global organizations including PayPal, Philip Morris International and Accenture, helping teams improve products, identify growth opportunities and make better investment decisions.

## How I work

I combine three perspectives that are often treated separately:

::: {.about-grid}

::: {.about-card}
### Business strategy

I begin with the business decision, not the model. I work with stakeholders to define the problem, clarify success metrics and identify where analytics can create meaningful value.
:::

::: {.about-card}
### Data science

I use experimentation, causal inference, predictive modeling and product analytics to turn complex data into practical and defensible recommendations.
:::

::: {.about-card}
### Leadership

I build teams, operating models and measurement systems that allow analytics to scale beyond individual projects and become part of how an organization makes decisions.
:::

:::
